topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: I just found out someone got my artwork tattooed on their arm. Part of me is flattered, it's a great honor to think someone likes my work that much. But there's so much to think about. Did they really understand the meaning behind the piece? And the design is intricate, I spent weeks perfecting it. I hope the tattoo artist did it justice. I wonder if I should reach out to them, maybe just to say thanks, if that's not too forward. It's all a bit overwhelming. I'll probably take a walk to clear my head, process this.
